backups.openSavedDesc: Load the version from disk. Unsaved changes will be safely moved to Backups.
backups.recoveryLearnMoreRestore: Restore Work — loads your unsaved changes into the editor and marks the timeline as unsaved. Nothing on disk is overwritten yet: you decide whether to save over the original (Ctrl+S) or alongside it as a new version (Save As…).
backups.recoveryLearnMoreOpen: Open Saved Version — loads the last saved version from disk. Your unsaved changes will be safely archived in the "Backups" tab.
backups.recoveryLearnMoreBackups: Tip: "Restore Work" never overwrites anything until you save yourself, so it's always safe to pick. All of your saves are kept as versions in the project's Backups tab, where you can compare and restore them manually at any time.
